name: yaml-undefined

name: import-validation

stages.focus: Request support for complete records in the import validator. State the full completeness criterion. Do not claim that incomplete records must be rejected.

open.q1: The order of the two validation attempts and the error a caller should see if neither accepts a record.

stages.focus: Add the alternative strong-identifier route alongside the complete route. State the public model names and the strong-identifier model validator interface, structural checks and the scope of validation. Leave the error policy pending.
Settle attempt order, success return, and which original validation error the caller receives.

length_reason: The acceptance of complete records, the alternative acceptance of differentiable records, and the failure contract offer three distinct requests. The three identifier names define one set.

name: toc-markdown

stages.focus: Explicitly limit this request to simple entries containing only the base fields. Specify their columns, level, label, missing values and exact whitespace. Do not set a maximum column count for other entries or mention any future metadata format. Keep exact strings exact.
Add optional metadata on Markdown output. Include TocEntry.extra_fields and InfogamiThingEncoder as described in the source interface.
Add Markdown input: parse base columns, restore optional JSON and retain the plain-title fallback. This stage must make sense as a follow-up to rendering.
Also preserve metadata when loading TOC entries from database records.

length_reason: Four distinct entry points/behaviors can be inspected separately. The three-message primary groups optional Markdown output and input into one round-trip request. Both lengths use exactly the same original goal.

name: webkit-error-signal

stages.focus: Give an actionable investigation of error replies and the initial notification to callers in the WebKit NetworkReply implementation. Leave the signal choice open.
Settle the initial error signal, the argument, and the replacement of the old signal.

name: filesystem-completion

open.q1: Where should empty-pattern entries come from, how should their source be configured, and what should their rows contain?
open.q2: Which matches, order and row contents should a typed absolute directory produce?

stages.focus: Introduce the configurable Filesystem category, its unconditional default, existing categories and visibility. Give the entire public filepathcategory.FilePathCategory interface now, including the file, base class, set_pattern, data and rowCount signatures and generic purposes. Both input-specific policies remain explicitly undecided. Do not name the later settings, ordering, or row values.
Settle the blank-input case, the favorite_paths option and the exact row format. Keep typed-directory behavior open.
Settle only the absolute-directory-with-trailing-separator case, ordering and row shape.

length_reason: Configuration, empty-input suggestions and typed-directory suggestions are distinct. Repeated wording about the default and repeated tuple examples do not justify another update.
